decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's strategy. By combining efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger with powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Kolaghan's Command, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while keeping their board in check. The inclusion of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress helps to disrupt the opponent's plans and clear the way for a quick victory. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and decisively.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on aggressive plays by sacrificing creatures for value with cards like Mayhem Devil and Witch's Oven. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's game plan. The deck's main strategy involves recurring Cauldron Familiar and forcing the opponent to make unfavorable trades with Claim the Firstborn. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana acceleration and flexibility to the deck's aggressive game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up a strong board presence of green creatures and utilize the devotion mechanic to ramp up mana production with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of threats while also utilizing powerful Planeswalkers like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator to support the aggro strategy. The inclusion of Storm the Festival and Invasion of Ixalan adds additional card advantage and utility to keep the pressure on the opponent.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to control the game through counter spells, removal, and card draw while utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck aims to establish board control, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and win through card advantage and powerful late-game threats like Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor. With a few creature threats and a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win.

The main concept of the deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive green creatures while utilizing devotion to green to ramp up mana quickly. The deck focuses on quickly building a strong board presence with creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn. Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional searching and power. The deck also includes cards like Oath of Nissa and Wolfwillow Haven for mana acceleration. Overall, the deck aims to overrun the opponent with powerful green creatures and utilize its devotion to green for maximum efficiency.

The main concept of this deck is to build up a strong board presence and ramp into powerful green devotion creatures quickly. By utilizing mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, along with mana acceleration spells like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the deck aims to play big threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll early on. The deck also includes Storm the Festival to search for more creatures and Karn, the Great Creator to provide additional utility and disruption. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with big green creatures and create a dominating board state.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play big spells and combo off with Lotus Field. It uses cards like Arboreal Grazer and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to accelerate mana production, while also utilizing cards like Hidden Strings and Pore Over the Pages for card draw and selection. Emergent Ultimatum and Behold the Beyond allow the player to tutor for key combo pieces, ultimately working towards setting up a win condition with Omniscience and powerful spells. The deck aims to control the board and generate massive amounts of mana to overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice mechanics to control the board and deal damage to the opponent quickly. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Unlucky Witness with cards like Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, the player can trigger abilities like Mayhem Devil to chip away at the opponent's life total. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Claim the Firstborn provide additional ways to steal and sacrifice creatures for advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing green devotion to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful threats. The deck focuses on mana acceleration through Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while also including cards like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns for strong board presence. Storm the Festival is used to find key creatures, and cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator help to generate additional value. The deck aims to close out games quickly with strong creatures and efficient mana usage.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize green mana devotion to ramp up quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and planeswalkers. By combining mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven, the deck aims to generate large amounts of mana to cast big threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival help to further accelerate the deck's game plan, while also providing card advantage and additional threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Greasefang Parhelion II to generate immense value and overwhelm the opponent. It includes various cards for card advantage, graveyard manipulation, and disruption to support the combo pieces. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and protect it while pressuring the opponent with a mix of creatures and planeswalkers. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck can achieve a powerful board presence and close out the game.

The deck focuses on creating a powerful combo using Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to generate an overwhelming advantage on the battlefield. It also includes cards like Raffine's Informant and Esika's Chariot to support the combo and provide additional value. The deck features strong disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil to control the game and protect the combo. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing the deck to execute its game plan efficiently.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bonecrusher Giant while disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize. It also has powerful late-game threats such as Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Liliana of the Veil to control the board and clear a path for its creatures to deal damage. The mana base includes utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear to provide additional advantages in different situations.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to pressure the opponent. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Misery's Shadow adds a graveyard recursion element to the deck, allowing for additional value and resilience. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, while maintaining card advantage and control of the game.

This aggro Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on generating value through sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester to trigger abilities like Mayhem Devil and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck also utilizes cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Claim the Firstborn to disrupt opponents and keep up the pressure. With a mixture of removal spells like Fatal Push and disruption like Thoughseize, the deck aims to control the board while dealing steady damage to the opponent, ultimately overwhelming them with constant threats and sacrificing synergies.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to stall the game with board wipes like Supreme Verdict and March of Otherworldly Light, while generating value with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value from blinking permanents. The deck also utilizes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana fixing and to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to outlast the opponent and outvalue them in the late game.
